source_name: PIB Fact Check, Press Information Bureau, Govt of India ('Screenshots of day-wise fact checks done by Fact Check Unit', linked from pib.gov.in/factcheck.aspx)
text:
Forwarded many times
Dear Sir,
You have been approve[…] an in[…] refund of Rs. 15,490 / -, th[…] be credited to your account shortly.  Please verify your account number 5XXXXX6755. If this is not correct, please update your bank account information by visiting the link below. https://bit.ly/20wpYK6
notes: Income-tax refund phishing message (PIB: '@IncomeTaxIndia has not sent this message'). Also on PDF page 12. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
